title: ch06_assessment
description: Logical Chapter Six classification snapshot; semantic meaning and obligations are in core_06-06_standing_assessment.md and core_07-07_standing_integration.md. Snapshots that drive standing effect must reflect verified standing inputs only (demonstrable Contribution Axis; verified violation findings for the Violation Axis per Chapter Six section 2 Verified inputs for standing and Chapter Five Verified Violation Findings); allegations and forum-phase material are not standing inputs. Cross-field rules (e.g. when axis_two is present, joint.highest_severity should equal axis_two.severity; no netting of severity via descriptors) may require validators beyond this schema or custom assertions.

assessment_id.description: Stable identifier for this assessment snapshot (UUID recommended).

subject_ref.description: Who or what is classified (URI or implementation-stable key).

evaluation_scope.description: Boundaries under which inputs were evaluated (jurisdiction, system, time window).

assessed_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime when the snapshot was issued.

assessor.description: Party responsible for the classification (role, system component, or office code).

rationale_uri.description: Optional pointer to auditable reasoning artifact.

descriptors.description: Supplemental D2-* tags; order not normative.

axis_two.description: Omit or null only when the record asserts no adverse Chapter Six violation typing for the declared scope.

legal_types.description: Subset of legal-constitutional types; empty array allowed only when legal typing is genuinely undetermined (rationale_uri should explain deferral).

highest_severity.description: When axis_two is non-null, MUST equal axis_two.severity for a coherent snapshot.

chapter_seven.description: Optional; populated only by the Chapter Eight top-slot process, not by Chapter Six inference alone. Prefer slot and label for new records; tier is legacy shorthand only.

slot.description: Final Chapter Eight Violation Axis slot for anti-constitutional misconduct.

label.description: Canonical Chapter Eight display label for the final slot.

tier.description: Legacy shorthand only: T1 maps to slot 7, T2 to slot 8, and T3 to slot 9.

reference.description: Link to tier determination packet, docket, or system record.

nine_slot.description: Optional numeric layer per implementation/CH06_NINE_SLOT_STANDING_SCALE.md: nine slots on each axis, Contribution Axis LEQU thresholds with a 5x multiplier anchored at s=7, and four Contribution Axis primary bands (C-BL s=1..2, C-PC s=3..4, C-SP s=5..6, C-CH s=7..9). Chapter Seven section 4.3 later groups verified Violation Axis slots for standing integration. Legacy-compatible category keys I|II|III and sub-tier keys minor|mid|major remain implementation helpers. Fields named category_tranche_display and category_tranche_role_display in ch06_nine_slot_constants.json are implementation display helpers retained for compatibility; the core Chapter Six presentation no longer treats tranche labels as independent constitutional categories. Contribution Axis display uses paired band-step labels through s=6 and recognized, distinguished, and exemplary champion at s=7..9 while retaining minor|mid|major interchange keys. Violation Axis s=1..3 displays non-compliance finding labels, s=4..6 displays violation finding labels, and s=7..9 displays Serious, Grave, and Pernicious anti-constitutional misconduct while retaining minor|mid|major interchange keys. Does not replace primary band/severity enums on axis_one and axis_two; does not override Chapter Six joint assessment, highest applicable non-compliance, or no-netting rules.

c_unit.description: Display scalar for LEQU thresholds; default c_unit=1 LEQU. Contribution threshold for slot s is c_unit * 5^(s-7) for s=2..9, with c_min(1)=0.

c_star_cumulative.description: Recency-weighted sum of verified contribution credit in LEQU (Chapter Seven §4.1) before slot assignment.

contribution_slot.description: Largest s in 1..9 such that c_star_cumulative >= c_min(s); omit if not computed from C*.

highest_finding_slot.description: Slot s of the severest open verified violation finding (1:1 from Violation Axis when using default map in CH06_NINE_SLOT_STANDING_SCALE.md).

v_star_sum.description: Optional sum of 3^(s-1) over findings; for analytics only, not a substitute for highest applicable severity (Chapter Seven §4.2).

violationSeverity.description: Chapter Six Violation Axis ladder. V-CSN is retained as the stable interchange key for Significant Substantive Non-Compliance. V-CPP and V-CGN are synonymous operational labels for the same level (V-CGN legacy; V-CPP in core_06-06_standing_assessment.md).
